description: Roles this project publishes on a flow object, as `RO:0000087 has role`. An allow-list over ChEBI's role tree, whose majority is biomedical and groups nothing an LCA asks about. Labels, definitions and `broader` are read from chebi.json.gz by tools/generate_chebi_roles.py; the membership is a judgement recorded in plans/pesticide-taxonomy.md.

roles.label: pesticide
roles.definition: Strictly, a substance intended to kill pests. In common usage, any substance used for controlling, preventing, or destroying animal, microbiological or plant pests.

roles.label: agrochemical
roles.definition: An agrochemical is a substance that is used in agriculture or horticulture.

roles.label: herbicide
roles.definition: A substance used to destroy plant pests.

roles.label: fungicide
roles.definition: A substance used to destroy fungal pests.

roles.label: insecticide
roles.definition: Strictly, a substance intended to kill members of the class Insecta. In common usage, any substance used for preventing, destroying, repelling or controlling insects.

roles.label: acaricide
roles.definition: A substance used to destroy pests of the subclass Acari (mites and ticks).

roles.label: plant growth regulator
roles.definition: A chemical, natural or artificial, that can affect the rate of growth of a plant.

roles.label: nematicide
roles.definition: A substance used to destroy pests of the phylum Nematoda (roundworms).

roles.label: fertilizer
roles.definition: A fertilizer is any substance that is added to soil or water to assist the growth of plants.

roles.label: rodenticide
roles.definition: A substance used to destroy rodent pests.

roles.label: molluscicide
roles.definition: A substance used to destroy pests of the phylum Mollusca.

roles.label: antifeedant
roles.definition: A substance that prevents pests from feeding.

roles.label: environmental contaminant
roles.definition: Any minor or unwanted substance introduced into the environment that can have undesired effects.

roles.label: persistent organic pollutant
roles.definition: Any environmental contaminant that is resistant to environmental degradation through photolytic, biological or chemical processes. Such substances can have significant impact on health and the environment, as they persist in the environment, bioaccumulate in animal tissue and so biomagnify in food chains.
